title: Boolean-influence supervision at a structurally latched recurrent proof-state boundary

parent_sources.qualified_original: AF-06 480-update shared warmup, original source commit 36b83eb83bc116dd4e938213edeba3057ffa9016
parent_sources.AF10: Reuse exact AF-10 causal-code latch and regular-feedback suffix implementation, including original hash-pinned TypedLoop. AF-10 diagnostic data and previous scored heldouts do not enter AF-11 fitting.

mathematics.rule: For Boolean G=AND(Q0,Q1) or OR(Q0,Q1), and one changed selected Qj, exact goal difference is (Qj_donor-Qj_recipient)*I_j; I_j=Q_other for AND and 1-Q_other for OR.
mathematics.kernel: BooleanInfluence.lean proves all four finite-difference truth-table identities on Lean 4.19.0 with no external axioms.
mathematics.transport: AF-10 cut guarantees exact preservation of both actual carried Q codes across downstream recurrence, regardless of source truth. A separate cut-free arm diagnoses feedback dependency.
mathematics.meaning: A passed Boolean derivative, structural cut, or closed synthetic Horn Lean theorem is not proof that a neural model discovers new Lean theorems.

data.training: Exact unchanged AF-05 training split: 672 cases at depths 2/3, permutations 0/1/2; only training cases used for updates.
data.development: Exact unchanged AF-05 development split: 224 cases at depths 2/3, permutation 3; qualification only.
data.original_horn_logic: Original AF-05 two independent Q0/Q1 Horn chains plus AND/OR final gate; unchanged fixed-point oracle. Fresh layouts are new physical permutations of these familiar logical templates. Claims must not describe them as new logical rule families.
data.fresh_receipt: fresh_manifest.json commits input-feature hashes and case IDs before training. Any overlap with AF-05 previous split feature hashes is an engineering failure.
data.donors: Exact opposite-selected-Q donor matched on graph skeleton and untouched independent two-leaf subproof; donor chosen by nearest Boolean-fact Hamming distance with lexicographic tie-breaking. Explicit source Horn closure independently rechecks the counterfactual goal.
data.no_oracle_leak: Model input is graph features, initial facts, role tags and incidence only. Q truth, goal, donor IDs, Boolean influence and counterfactual labels are never encoded into model input features.

training.runtime: Python 3.12, torch 2.5.1+cpu, two CPU threads, deterministic algorithms
training.shared_start: Each seed starts from its own source-hash and training-receipt-verified AF-06 warmup. One shared 160-update causal-cut adaptation is trained on exact original train cases before four continuation arms branch off with identical model tensors.
training.fairness: All continuation arms replay identical per-seed minibatch, changed-status donors and selected addresses, and execute the same two recurrent prefixes and three downstream suffixes per training row. Cut status baseline supervises clean/other status and addressed-Q status. Counterfactual cut receives exact addressed target supervision. Influence cut adds a signed Boolean finite-difference goal loss. Influence ordinary receives identical influence loss with the cut disabled. Gradients and loss arithmetic differ across objectives, so total FLOPs are not equal.
training.selection: Exactly the final step of each fixed 160-step continuation is frozen regardless of train/development or heldout performance; no restart/step tuning on heldout. Record shared cut-adaptation metrics and all four model exports per seed.
training.qualification: Shared cut checkpoint and both primary compared arm checkpoints each reach >=0.90 original-goal accuracy AND >=0.90 exact joint-Q accuracy separately on both train and development. Other arms are separately labeled.

scoring.primary: For each qualified seed and BOTH fresh_depth4 and fresh_depth5: influence_cut - counterfactual_cut informative-goal-flip accuracy >=0.05; influence_cut informative-goal-flip >=0.80; influence_cut goal correctness on noninformative patches >=0.90; clean original goal >= counterfactual_cut -0.03; false-positive patched goals <= counterfactual_cut. Any eligible failure -> FAIL, all seeds eligible/pass -> PASS, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
scoring.secondary: Report heldout prefix joint-Q exact and prefix-conditioned goal-flip correctness, as well as non-cut influence comparison and depth3/layout diagnostics. A low upstream prefix-Q accuracy is a separate error mechanism and cannot be hidden by structural code latching.
scoring.episode_roster: Each held-out canonical input appears for selected j=0 and j=1 for each of four arms. 656 canonical cases per arm and 1,312 counterfactuals per arm per seed. Two seeds produce 10,496 scored counterfactual rows.
scoring.independent_replay: Compare every row against a separately recomputed Boolean AND/OR truth function and original Horn least-fixed-point oracle; assert original donor identity and signed Boolean influence. Recompute metrics from raw logits, verify original model/npz bytes and source hashes, and forward-replay two cases per family per arm. Zero protected-code violations are required of cut arms.
scoring.semantic_boundary: Lean BooleanInfluence proof checks a finite Boolean identity; original AF-05 Lean certificates support the reference oracle; neural predictions and causal performance are scored separately.

failure_policy: All source/compilation, oracle, training and audit integrity errors fail engineering CI. Registered scientific hypotheses have separate pass/fail/inconclusive verdicts. Preserve all models, ineligible sources, negative controls, and source revisions. Keep AF-01 through AF-10 unchanged and new PR draft/unmerged.
